description: Builds versioned nationwide state, county, and ZCTA polygon releases from U.S. Census TIGERweb.

spatial_zip_polygon_denominator.selection_scope: complete selected Census-published ZCTA5 polygon set for the declared source layer and vintage
spatial_zip_polygon_denominator.completeness_gate: complete_national_release must be true, every selected ZCTA artifact must verify, and coverage.zctas must equal coverage.source_available_counts.zctas

retry: Exponential backoff for HTTP and service errors; fail after four total attempts.
checkpoint: Artifacts are written to an immutable run-scoped staging directory.
idempotency: Each build creates a unique immutable release and atomically updates current.json after publication.
cancellation: Abort active HTTP requests; run-scoped staging never blocks a later build.
retention_profile: Retain immutable releases until an explicitly approved retention operation removes them.
